payload.goal: Implement eng-init Agent Engineering Readiness Control Plane upgrade from eng-init-control-plane-upgrade.spec.md with proof-gated review, evolution, and swe-agent validation.

validationContract.title: SKILL.md defines control-plane routing
validationContract.description: SKILL.md presents eng-init as a repo-local Agent Engineering Readiness Control Plane skill and routes Audit, Initialize, Repair, and Refactor Harness.
validationContract.passCriteria: File evidence shows control-plane positioning, AGENTS.md interface framing, and four pipeline routing.
validationContract.failCriteria: SKILL.md remains artifact-first, omits routing, or weakens existing strictness/no-phantom/refactor rules.

validationContract.title: Readiness report contract drives repair
validationContract.description: Readiness report reference defines deterministic audit/report lifecycle and repair-usable output.
validationContract.passCriteria: Reference evidence includes application discovery, denominator stability, previous report behavior, partial credit, control-plane summary, and priority actions.
validationContract.failCriteria: Report remains non-deterministic, score-only, or cannot drive repair.

validationContract.title: Repair recipes prevent fake fixes
validationContract.description: Repair recipe reference defines fixability classes, validators, rescore evidence, and high-value recipes.
validationContract.passCriteria: readiness-fix-recipes.md exists with universal rules, fixability classes, schema, and required initial recipes.
validationContract.failCriteria: No recipe reference, no validators, or allows placeholder/disabled-check fixes.

validationContract.title: Regression eval coverage exists
validationContract.description: Eval cases include the new lifecycle coverage specified by the spec.
validationContract.passCriteria: cases.md includes five new observable cases and existing cases are preserved.
validationContract.failCriteria: New cases missing, subjective-only, or existing cases weakened/deleted.

validationContract.title: Independent review and remediation complete
validationContract.description: Independent review completed and all findings dispositioned.
validationContract.passCriteria: Review output has findings or approval, and every finding has disposition with follow-up evidence.
validationContract.failCriteria: Review skipped, same-agent review only, or unresolved blocker findings.

validationContract.title: Self-evolution pass completes
validationContract.description: Bounded self-evolution pass records weaknesses, mutations, decisions, and final rationale.
validationContract.passCriteria: Evolution log shows baseline, weaknesses, attempted improvements, keep/discard decisions, and final rationale.
validationContract.failCriteria: No evolution pass or ungrounded keep/discard decisions.

validationContract.title: swe-agent real-project test completes
validationContract.description: New eng-init behavior is exercised against swe-agent in read-only audit/spec-preview style.
validationContract.passCriteria: Raw evidence records mode routing/audit behavior on swe-agent and any skill feedback is resolved or logged.
validationContract.failCriteria: No swe-agent test, destructive writes without approval, or unhandled test failures.
